result.rationale: The diff shows `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` in EmbeddableHost.record_for_host and a before_validation that only strips scheme/path without downcasing (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`). The SQL lowercases the stored column but not the comparison parameter, and since URI#host preserves the URL's original case while the validation regex permits uppercase, a mixed-case stored host or a mixed-case referer URL can fail to match a correctly registered host, breaking embedding authorization. The mechanism is verifiable directly from the diff lines.

judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` lowercases only the stored side while `URI(host).host` preserves case and `before_validation` never downcases, so a referer/embed URL with a mixed-case host (`http://EvilTrout.com/...`) is rejected even though the same host is registered (severity P3, confidence 50, advisory)
